acceptance_criteria.criterion: The enumeration accepts the member `source_node_id` with the exact meaning the spec states: reference | the in-document object being tiled | --. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `tile_type` with the exact meaning the spec states: enumeration | `tile.rectangular = RECTANGULAR`, `tile.hex_by_row = HORIZONTAL_HEXAGONAL`, `tile.hex_by_column = VERTICAL_HEXAGONAL` | unknown. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `scaling_factor` with the exact meaning the spec states: numeric | hard/soft unknown, unit `ratio`, precision unknown | unknown. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `spacing` with the exact meaning the spec states: vector (x, y) | hard/soft unknown, unit `document_unit`, precision unknown | unknown. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `horizontal_alignment` with the exact meaning the spec states: enumeration | `align.start = START`, `align.center = CENTER`, `align.end = END` | unknown. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence or table row in the cited spec clause. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication and fails the contract.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
For a parameter row, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown rather than mirrored from its opposite.
